title: You might want to skip using a Bluetooth headset for a better gaming experience - Engadget
summary: The three main connection types (Bluetooth, 2.4GHz wireless and wired) each handle latency, audio quality and stability in distinct ways. Either way, Bluetooth generally lags behind 2.4GHz wireless and wired connections for gaming.
